$comment: Read by the map-guardian pre-edit hook (.claude/hooks/map-guardian.mjs) (fires on Edit/Write before the change is applied) and by the first-touch context injector for this repo. For each entry, if the new file content contains one of `triggers`, AND the target file's repo-relative path is not one of `canonical` (exact match, or matches as a path suffix) and does not contain one of `exempt` as a substring, AND none of the canonical files' basenames (extension stripped) already appear anywhere in the new-plus-existing file content, the edit is DENIED with a message pointing at the canonical file(s) — the intent is to stop a second implementation of something that already exists from being written silently.

entries.$comment: name: human-readable label for this capability, used in the deny message and in the first-touch summary shown to an agent.
entries.name: date picker
entries.$comment_canonical: canonical: repo-relative path(s) that ARE the allowed implementation(s) of this capability. Editing one of these files themselves is always allowed.
entries.$comment_triggers: triggers: substrings that, if found in newly written content, suggest the agent is about to reimplement this capability from scratch — a function/class/component name or a distinctive library call is more reliable than a generic word.
entries.$comment_exempt: exempt: substrings matched against the repo-relative path; any file whose path contains one of these may write matching content anyway (tests, generated code, a legacy directory kept for reference).
entries.$comment_use: use: optional one-line guidance shown alongside the capability name — when to reach for the canonical piece instead of writing new code.
entries.use: Any UI surface that needs a calendar date input should import components/shared/DatePicker.tsx rather than wrapping a date library again.
